top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a sharp, falsifiable prediction (Kane and Mele: time-reversal symmetry plus spin-orbit coupling gives a Z2 invariant and protected helical edge states without a field) and its first experimental confirmation in HgTe quantum wells (Molenkamp), with about two decades of stable transport and ARPES interpretation. A citation confined to the two-dimensional quantum spin Hall effect keeps the three-dimensional programme and the 2016 topological phase transition work outside it. The omission of Bernevig, Hughes and Zhang is a real boundary weakness that should be recorded openly, but it does not outweigh the maturity and conceptual reach; P002 is a close, cleanly attributed second and P003 is less mature with experimental credit resting on one name.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; my documented connections (PAMELA, Fermi-LAT, PoGO+, XL-Calibur, KTH) do not involve any credited laureate in P001, P002 or P003
